status: Research recommendations, not new user approvals or real-market validation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Match market baselines by session/slot/feed
hypotheses.basis: Seasonal and flat-control matched simulations
hypotheses.conditions_or_boundary: No real calendar, regime or threshold validation; field admission first

hypotheses.hypothesis: Median/MAD as inspectable initial unusualness context
hypotheses.basis: Contamination counterexamples and fixed prior baselines
hypotheses.conditions_or_boundary: Not a probability; degenerate MAD/high contamination and drift still require abstention

hypotheses.hypothesis: Separate raw market movement from prior market-adjusted context
hypotheses.basis: Stable-beta and beta-drift comparisons
hypotheses.conditions_or_boundary: Do not suppress market-wide events; prior fit/stability conditions and real evaluation pending

hypotheses.hypothesis: Apply financial BH/BY or conformal tail guarantees
hypotheses.basis: Valid Gaussian versus invalid heavy-tail probability comparisons; calibration resolution
hypotheses.conditions_or_boundary: Financial null validity/dependence/drift and time horizon must be established

hypotheses.hypothesis: Correction or robust-score magnitude alone guarantees financial false-discovery control
hypotheses.basis: Heavy-tail misspecification defeats BH/BY
hypotheses.conditions_or_boundary: Valid probabilities are a prerequisite, not supplied by a robust score

hypotheses.hypothesis: Episode-aware candidate aggregation and material revisions
hypotheses.basis: Constructed repeated-feature and cooldown counterexamples
hypotheses.conditions_or_boundary: Oracle grouping is not implemented causal episode discovery

hypotheses.hypothesis: A blind fixed cooldown can safely replace event identity
hypotheses.basis: Separate material event is suppressed
hypotheses.conditions_or_boundary: Use verified episode/revision/material-change policy, evaluated prospectively

hypotheses.hypothesis: Matched fund endpoint residual as end-period unit-value estimate
hypotheses.basis: Independent exact ledger and Decimal identity combinations
hypotheses.conditions_or_boundary: Specify scope/raw NAV/actions/timing; estimate is not generally cash

hypotheses.hypothesis: Sparse AUM/NAV/units endpoints identify exact cash or security selling
hypotheses.basis: Identical endpoints with different cash and redemption funding paths
hypotheses.conditions_or_boundary: Need transaction/flow/trade evidence for those targets

hypotheses.hypothesis: Investor-count decline establishes monetary outflow direction
hypotheses.basis: Same count decrease permits negative/zero/positive cash
hypotheses.conditions_or_boundary: Retain comparable count change as its own observation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Allocation distance measures realized turnover or current holdings
hypotheses.basis: Revaluation, round-trip and stale snapshot alternatives
hypotheses.conditions_or_boundary: Retain dated composition changes; trade/position evidence separate

hypotheses.hypothesis: Propagate justified numeric bounds and unresolved threshold crossing
hypotheses.basis: 48 input-corner checks
hypotheses.conditions_or_boundary: Bounds must come from data/precision evidence; not a confidence interval or cure for scope/time errors

hypotheses.hypothesis: Bind eligible immutable revisions, config and explicit replay knowledge basis
hypotheses.basis: Frozen bundle/config/late-archive counterexamples
hypotheses.conditions_or_boundary: Toy model only; real code/dependency/rights/universe manifests and source authentication needed

hypotheses.hypothesis: Latest rows or last arrivals recreate what the actual engine knew
hypotheses.basis: Cutoff and permutation/revision rollback examples
hypotheses.conditions_or_boundary: Actually ingested and source-available reconstruction answer different questions

hypotheses.hypothesis: Use dated canonicality/finality and exact dependency state gates
hypotheses.basis: Reorg/future-finalization/binding/invalid-state cases
hypotheses.conditions_or_boundary: No RPC/consensus/database/outbox/concurrency proof; exact networks after spikes

hypotheses.hypothesis: Confirmed equals finalized; transfer equals sale; token account equals beneficial owner
hypotheses.basis: Protocol semantics and authored transfer/authority fixtures
hypotheses.conditions_or_boundary: Retain raw observation with units, coverage and interpretation limits

hypotheses.hypothesis: Citation existence, correct arithmetic or repeated text establishes claim support
hypotheses.basis: Weaker policy ablations emit fixture-unsupported claims
hypotheses.conditions_or_boundary: Typed scope, lineage, metric allowlist, dependency and render coverage needed

hypotheses.hypothesis: Claim-level typed dependencies, contradiction checks and closed rendering
hypotheses.basis: Hand-authored adversarial policy cases
hypotheses.conditions_or_boundary: Does not extract/validate arbitrary Turkish prose or authenticate real sources

hypotheses.hypothesis: Distinct sources or a high metadata score establish world truth probability
hypotheses.basis: Deliberate source-supported but world-false fact; heuristic-score counterexample
hypotheses.conditions_or_boundary: Original roots are not guaranteed causal/statistical independence or truth

hypotheses.hypothesis: Production investigator/reviewer semantic correctness and calibrated confidence
hypotheses.basis: No real LLM or independently parsed corpus
hypotheses.conditions_or_boundary: Strict output schemas, actual runtime/source evaluations and independently defined truth target required

hypotheses.hypothesis: Bounded staged investigation with shared eligible event context and reservations
hypotheses.basis: Authored tool/time/source budget-policy cases
hypotheses.conditions_or_boundary: No measured model costs/latency/affordability; private context/rights/config separate

hypotheses.hypothesis: Retrospective point-adjusted F1 proves timely detection
hypotheses.basis: Random flags can score highly after future-label-aware segment expansion
hypotheses.conditions_or_boundary: Report actual first alert/misses/burden and target-specific point/event metrics

hypotheses.hypothesis: Learned market models, accuracy/calibration or loss-prevention claims
hypotheses.basis: No licensed empirical observations or labels in these labs
hypotheses.conditions_or_boundary: Freeze point-in-time datasets, protocol and untouched evaluation periods first
